slides.label: Saturday 5 December, about noon
slides.title:
Into Capricorn
and Cancer
body: The magician (Rahu) walks backward into Capricorn, and the monk (Ketu) into Cancer. They stay about a year and a half.

slides.label: Rao’s Nadi table
slides.title:
One grows,
one narrows
body: Rahu stands for bigness, Ketu for smallness. Where Rahu lands, a matter grows. Where Ketu lands, it gets smaller and simpler.
slides.note: R. G. Rao, Fundamentals, ch. 7 · Sutram’s reading

slides.title: Mark your calendar
items: The messenger (Mercury) walks into Scorpio and joins the king (Sun)
Saturn and Jupiter slow toward a stop: Saturn turns forward on 10 December, Jupiter backward on 12 December
The Moon walks into Libra and meets the lover (Venus), at home there
